text:
rachel_am: SwanBridge wants to flip a POC from CompetitorA to Redwood next week. Their checklist: firm pricing for ~10M tokens/mo, header-preserve behavior for legacy auth, streaming framing compatibility (they expect length-prefix frames), exact JSON parity (they care about key order for downstream parsers), stop-sequence trimming semantics, completed security questionnaire, and per-request token logs for audit. Can we triage blockers now?

paul_sol: I can own pricing + framing. Pricing: fits mid-tier; propose a one-month promotional credit (40%) to accelerate sign. Framing: CompetitorA does 4-byte big-endian length-prefixed chunks. Our SSE/newline stream can be adapted by a thin adapter that prefixes lengths server-side. Need to measure per-chunk latency delta; estimate 5-20ms.

emily_eng: For stop-sequence behavior we currently stream raw tokens until the stop is observed and include the stop token in some cases. CompetitorA strips stop tokens and collapses multiple trailing newlines. I can add a route flag allow_stop_strip=true to post-process output for parity. Also can add a route-level preserve_headers list.

diego_sec: Security: Data residency OK via Dedicated (us-west-2) or Private. Customer-managed KMS: only supported on Private; for Hosted we'd need a key escrow workaround (not ideal). Per-request logs are fine under NDA but retention and PII treatment must be defined. I'll prepare targeted answers for their questionnaire and surface any CISO/legal gates.

harper_cs: I've asked SwanBridge for concrete request/response examples, the exact header names they need preserved (they mentioned X-Client, X-Swan-Auth), and their tokenization settings (model/codec + rounding). They've uploaded a zip to presales: https://redwood.app/drive/swanbridge/presales — asked them to redact secrets. They want our questionnaire answers by Friday.

paul_sol: Billing rounding note: SwanBridge rounds up per 7-token buckets today (weird). We can match rounding on invoice generation; finance will need to produce a sample invoice PDF showing per-route line items and per-request sample logs. Flagging finance.

emily_eng: Quick ingress snippet I will test in staging: ```nginx
# translator ingress allowlist
proxy_set_header X-Preserve "x-client,x-swan-auth,x-trace-id";
``` Also proto for frame adapter: ```ts
// server adapter
while (chunk = readSSE()) { writeUInt32BE(chunk.length); write(chunk); }
```

diego_sec: If they insist on Authorization passthrough with third-party tokens across tenancy boundaries, legal wants to review. Also if they want raw request bodies persisted for auditing we need CISO sign-off and hardened retention policies.

ci-bot: ci-bot: staging namespace rwd-swan-poc is provisioned on rwd-canary-7. Ephemeral creds created at 1827770100, expire in 48h. Recommend tests: 1) length-prefixed stream smoke (20 prompts), 2) stop-strip parity test (50 prompts, mixed stops), 3) header passthrough verification. Logs will be collected to /var/presales/swanbridge.

harper_cs: SwanBridge confirmed X-Client and X-Swan-Auth are required; they will redact secrets and provided sample payloads. They accept the 40% trial credit. They also asked whether function-calling hooks are preserved during translation (they rely on structured tool calls).

emily_eng: Good catch — function-calls: we preserve JSON function-call envelope, but downstream key-order differences can break brittle parsers. We'll provide a server-side normalization option canonicalize_json_keys=true that orders keys deterministically. That + stop-strip should cover parity.

paul_sol: Action items: Emily - PR for frame adapter + stop-strip + canonicalize_json_keys; run smoke in rwd-swan-poc and post latency numbers. Diego - draft security questionnaire answers and list items requiring CISO/legal. Harper - get their exact header list and upload tokenization config. Rachel - assemble SOW + invoice sample once smoke logs are green. ETA: smoke results by tomorrow 10:00.

harper_cs: Uploaded their completed questionnaire and sample traffic (redacted) to the presales drive. Also uploaded their current invoice PDF for formatting.

diego_sec: Drafted answers for network/auth/KMS. Marked raw-body retention and Authorization passthrough as legal/CISO review items. Linking draft in drive.

emily_eng: Will push a smoke branch this afternoon and run the three tests. If green, Paul please send POC pricing and SOW.

paul_sol: Will prepare POC SOW and sample invoice. If smoke passes, propose signing and a 30-day POC with 40% promo.

rachel_am: Thanks team. Let's reconvene after the smoke. :thumbsup:
